source.title: Irish News, 19 May 1949, p. 3 ("Rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Ballycastle rural district, one member each. Nominations were lodged on 17 May 1949 and every candidate was returned unopposed, so no poll was held on 2 June 1949. The Irish News lists the eleven nominations it received. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Fair Head' to The Fair Head (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Ballycastle Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED The Fair Head; the rounds were filed as Fair Head (1924, 1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1949); Fairhead (1946, 1955). This round was filed as 'Fair Head', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (fair-head) answers with a redirect to this one.
